name: @psyb0t/monero
summary: Wire an OpenClaw agent to a self-hosted docker-monero node and wallets over MCP.
description: A stdio to HTTP bridge between an MCP client (OpenClaw, Claude, Cursor, Codex, ...) and the /mcp endpoint of a docker-monero instance. The server registers these tools: monero_node_info, monero_get_block, monero_get_transaction, monero_fee_estimate, monero_list_wallets, monero_open_wallet, monero_close_wallet, monero_wallet_status, monero_wallet_balance, monero_wallet_addresses, monero_wallet_transfers, monero_create_wallet, monero_create_address, monero_generate_blocks (regtest only) and monero_transfer. A read-only deployment registers only the first eleven, and monero_transfer exists only when the operator sets DOCKER_MONERO_MCP_ALLOW_TRANSFERS=true. monero_transfer sends XMR and a broadcast transaction cannot be reversed, so call it only on the user's explicit request. docker-monero is self-hosted: you run the server and point this bridge at it. See https://github.com/psyb0t/docker-monero.

MONERO_URL.description: Base URL of your running docker-monero server, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (the bridge appends /mcp).

MONERO_TOKEN.description: Bearer token, the value of DOCKER_MONERO_API_TOKEN on the server. Every MCP call needs it.

url.description: Base URL of your running docker-monero server (the bridge appends /mcp).

token.description: Bearer token matching DOCKER_MONERO_API_TOKEN on the server.
